# A03-D01: Textsplainer

Artwork text. The source wording is retained.

[…]

textsplainer

the dialogue is a presentation of an artistic project, 
 which will be developed at mindfuture foundation from March to August twenty twenty-two.

you can kind of watch along before you have to go to work.

since there is no ‘consciousness’ behind the text, 
 the bourgeois public sphere’s politeness requirement that 
 one must read the whole thing also falls away.

it doesn’t make much sense to have a hermeneutics for artificial intelligences.

the dialogue is made with a technically updated version of the French literary technique “détournement.”

that means an artist takes a base text and changes its purpose 
 by putting it into a new context and fixing a bit here and there.

so the text is a bit like this newsletter, 
 which imagines a couple of newly employed art directors interviewing each other: https://arthubcopenhagen.net/wp-content/uploads/2021/05/Newsletter-8.pdf.

but now we are talking about what could be called a “neural détournement” with a term invented for the occasion, since the base text has been amplified through a pretrained language model (gpt-3).

such can keep a certain style going for quite a long time.

in addition, the text is posted on a blog and filmed with an iPhone 11.

so you can also just watch.

[…]
